usdRate.sourceName: ECCB Monetary Council, communique of the 113th meeting (10 July 2026), reported by Discover MNI
usdRate.note: Fixed exchange rate of EC$2.70 per US dollar, in place for 50 years; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF also gives 2.7 for 2025.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, Grenada inflation rate (Central Statistical Office CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: annual CPI inflation 2.0% in June 2026 (2.06% in May); the CSO and ECCB CPI pages could not be read (CSO site lists releases only to 2024, ECCB site blocks automated access).

inflation_projection.sourceName: IMF WEO (2026 forecast 1.3%, medium term about 2%); World Bank CPI 0.6% for 2025; EC dollar pegged at 2.70 per US dollar
inflation_projection.note: The ECCB has no inflation target (the EC dollar is pegged to the US dollar), so we plan with about 2%, in line with US-dollar inflation and recent Grenada readings of 0.6-2%.

policy_rate.sourceName: ECCB Monetary Council, communique of the 113th meeting (10 July 2026), reported by Discover MNI
policy_rate.note: ECCB discount rate 3.0% for short-term credit (4.5% long-term), unchanged; applies to all ECCU members including Grenada. Secondary copy of the communique (the ECCB site blocks automated reading).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECCB Monetary Council, communique of the 113th meeting (10 July 2026): Minimum Savings Rate
savings_account_rate.note: The ECCB Minimum Savings Rate of 2.0% is the floor banks must pay on savings deposits; banks' posted savings rates are generally at or near this floor.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Searched ECCB statistics and Grenada sources: the ECCB interest-rate tables by country could not be read (site blocks automated access) and no other public source gives a 3-month time deposit rate for Grenada.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Searched ECCB statistics and Grenada sources: no readable public figure for a 12-month time deposit rate in Grenada; the World Bank average deposit rate (all deposits) was 0.95% in 2025.

dps_rate.note: Searched ECCB and Grenada sources: no monthly recurring deposit product rate is published.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate paid by commercial banks on deposits, 2025 (ECCB data via IMF IFS).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Searched Government of Grenada and ECCB/RGSM sources: no government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; government borrowing is through Treasury bills on the Regional Government Securities Market.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The Government of Grenada sells 91-day Treasury bills on the Regional Government Securities Market (a June 2026 auction cleared near 3.5%), but the result is published only by the regional securities exchange company, which may not be cited; the ECCB site blocks automated access.

tbond_5y_rate.note: Searched RGSM and ECCB debt pages: no current 5-year Government of Grenada bond yield is published.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Searched RGSM and ECCB debt pages: no current 10-year Government of Grenada bond yield is published.

tax_bank_interest.note: Interest accruing from deposits to individuals resident in Grenada is exempt from income tax (since 31 March 1995); s.53 sets 0% withholding on deposit interest to non-residents. Consolidated text dated 2021 (older than 2025).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists for individuals in Grenada (see sanchayapatra_5y_rate), so no tax rate applies; the Income Tax Act exempts only interest on government loans declared exempt by the Minister (s.25(1)(f)).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Grenada passed the Eastern Caribbean Deposit Insurance Corporation Agreement Bill 2025 (https://grenadaparliament.gd/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Eastern-Caribbean-Deposit-Insurance-Corporation-Agreement-Bill-2025.pdf), but no evidence was found that the regional corporation is operating or that a coverage limit has been set.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: Searched ECCB and GARFIN sources: no legal cap on credit card interest and no official typical rate published for Grenada.

equity_return_low.sourceName: ECCB Monetary Council (July 2026): discount rate 3%, minimum savings rate 2%, EC$2.70 per US$1 peg
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the regional share market is very small, so savers rely on global equity funds in pegged US-dollar terms, and a weak decade is possible.

equity_return_base.sourceName: ECCB Monetary Council (July 2026): discount rate 3%, minimum savings rate 2%, EC$2.70 per US$1 peg
equity_return_base.note: Base case uses a global equity index in EC-dollar terms (pegged to the US dollar), kept within 4 points of the tax-free 2% minimum savings rate because the local market has no usable 10-year record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: ECCB Monetary Council (July 2026): discount rate 3%, minimum savings rate 2%, EC$2.70 per US$1 peg
equity_return_high.note: High case if global equities repeat their strong long-run US-dollar returns.

gold_return_low.sourceName: ECCB: EC$2.70 per US$1 fixed exchange rate (113th Monetary Council communique)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price; the 50-year peg means no currency boost.

gold_return_base.sourceName: ECCB: EC$2.70 per US$1 fixed exchange rate (113th Monetary Council communique)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year, with no expected depreciation of the pegged EC dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: ECCB: EC$2.70 per US$1 fixed exchange rate (113th Monetary Council communique)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold prices.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% and discount rate 3% (July 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 0.95% (2025)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings and short deposits near the 0.95% average deposit rate (2025), tax-free for residents.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% and discount rate 3% (July 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 0.95% (2025)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: tax-free deposits around the ECCB 2% minimum savings rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% and discount rate 3% (July 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 0.95% (2025)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer deposits or government paper at about the 3% ECCB discount rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Searched GARFIN Supervisor of Insurance reports and news: only claim totals are published (latest found for 2018), no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold in Grenada by regional insurers, but no regulator or public source publishes premium rates by age; only individual insurer quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Searched Ministry of Health and news sources: public General Hospital fees are low and not published as a typical bill; no official figure for a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Searched GARFIN and public sources: no published individual health insurance premiums by age.

goal_inflation_health.note: No long-run medical CPI series found; headline planning inflation plus 2 points for private and overseas medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.note: No long-run education CPI series found; headline planning inflation plus 1.5 points.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 75.7 for 2026 (men 72.8, women 78.8).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; sex-specific values are for the 5-year age groups starting at each age; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 18.5 (2025, World Bank), 24.2 (2040) and 50.7 (2065, populationpyramid.net/grenada/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Insurance (Amendment) (No. 2) Bill 2023, Third Schedule (Parliament of Grenada)
retirement_age_default.note: National Insurance (Amendment) (No. 2) Act 2023, Third Schedule: pensionable age 61 in 2024, 62 in 2025, 63 in 2026, 64 in 2027 and 65 from 1 January 2028, so 65 applies to anyone born after 1975. In force 1 January 2024 (law from 2023, older than 2025; bill text read).

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Jamaica Observer, 'Grenada says new pension scheme favourable to civil servants' (31 December 2024)
retirement_age_government.note: Attorney General quoted: public officers work until 60 or 26 2/3 years of service; early retirement at 50 with 20 years. A new Public Sector Employees (Pension Fund) scheme was proposed in 2024. News source from 2024 (older than 2025).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% and discount rate 3% (July 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly tax-free savings deposits near the 0.95% average deposit rate.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% and discount rate 3% (July 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case equal to the tax-free 2% minimum savings rate, the best confirmed safe rate, kept liquid in retirement.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% and discount rate 3% (July 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer deposits or government paper near the 3% ECCB discount rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% (July 2026); global equity assumptions in pegged EC dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if global equities disappoint.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% (July 2026); global equity assumptions in pegged EC dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half global equities at 6% and half tax-free deposits at about 2%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: ECCB minimum savings rate 2% (July 2026); global equity assumptions in pegged EC dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with stronger equity returns.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: HelpAge Pension Watch (https://www.helpage.org/country_profile/grenada/) states that Grenada does not currently have a social pension (0% of people 60+ receive one); poor elderly people can only apply for means-tested Public Assistance.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension exists in Grenada (HelpAge Pension Watch, https://www.helpage.org/country_profile/grenada/).

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory retirement gratuity: severance under the Employment Act (s.84 of Cap. 89, https://grenadaparliament.gd/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/Cap89-EMPLOYMENT-ACT.pdf, and s.86 of the Employment Act 2016) is paid only on dismissal and not to an employee over the NIS pensionable age (as amended by the National Insurance (Amendment) (No. 2) Act 2023).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Insurance (Amendment) (No. 2) Bill 2023 (Parliament of Grenada), amending the National Insurance Act Cap. 205
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory contributory NIS age pension for insured persons aged 16 up to the pensionable age (rising to 65 from 2028), per the National Insurance (Amendment) (No. 2) Act 2023. No automatic indexation was found; tax treatment not confirmed. Law from 2023 (older than 2025).

fdr_3m.note: Offered by commercial banks and credit unions; no public rate table found.

fdr_1y.note: Offered by commercial banks and credit unions; no public rate table found.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned on the Regional Government Securities Market through licensed intermediaries; mostly bought by institutions.

tbond_5y.note: No regular 5-year government bond issue for retail found.

tbond_10y.note: No regular 10-year government bond issue for retail found.

equity_fund.note: No locally registered retail equity or index fund was identified; the regional share market is very small.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold; mostly sold as jewellery.

centralBank.name: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank (ECCB)
centralBank.note: Shared central bank of the Eastern Caribbean Currency Union.

insuranceRegulator.name: Grenada Authority for the Regulation of Financial Institutions (GARFIN)

insuranceComplaints.name: Grenada Authority for the Regulation of Financial Institutions (GARFIN)
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman; complaints go to GARFIN.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (public hospitals and free district health centres)

statistics.name: Central Statistical Office, Ministry of Finance
